summary: Healthcare and environmental programmes in emerging countries benefit from Iaso, a geospatial data management platform. It supports geo-rich data collection efforts, mainly in public health, by linking surveys to organisational units within a canonical hierarchy. The platform has been used in multiple data collection efforts, including Performance Based Financing of health services in several African countries. Iaso enables continuous improvements of geographic references through routine activities, such as locating and registering health facilities. The tool addresses the sectors of health, environment, and social development, with a focus on low-income countries and rural areas. Its impact is to improve the planning, monitoring, and evaluation of health, environmental, or social programmes.
